mainEntity.name: What should I do first if I want AI to make a presentation or lesson?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with one defined learning objective, then use AI to create an outline, draft slides, speaker notes, or practice activities around it. For Run My AI Biz readers, a course-building or presentation workflow can turn a topic into draft lessons and supporting materials, but the owner must supply the audience, level, examples, and approval criteria. Context: AI is most useful for reducing blank-page work, not deciding what learners need to know. A narrowly scoped first lesson is easier to review than an entire course. Key factors: audience knowledge, learning objective, source material, lesson length, and assessment method. Practical guidance: Give the system a trusted source or your own outline, request editable output, and check each claim before sharing. Run My AI Biz emphasizes focused implementation: build one assistant or workflow, use it, then expand. This approach can make educational content creation more manageable without presenting AI output as finished instruction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Define the learning objective and audience first. Then ask AI for an outline or draft, provide reliable source material, and review every slide, activity, and assessment before use.
